name: MLK Foods Public Company Ltd.
summary: MLK Foods Public Company Ltd, known as Milkiland Public Company Limited until its name change in January 2022, is a leading producer and distributor of dairy products. The company primarily serves markets in the European Union and CIS countries, additionally exporting its offerings to roughly 30 nations worldwide. Its operations are structured into three key segments: Cheese & Butter, Whole-Milk, and Ingredients. The diverse product range encompasses various types of cheeses (hard, mould, fresh, processed, and creamy), a selection of dairy beverages including sterilized and pasteurized milk, kefir, and ryazhenka, as well as cream, sour cream, and tvorog. They also provide drinkable and spoonable bio yoghurts and develop private label products for retailers. For industrial customers such as confectioneries and bakeries, MLK Foods supplies butter and a comprehensive suite of milk and whey powders, including skimmed milk powder, whole milk powder, various demineralized and sweet whey powders, whey protein concentrate, and demineralized permeate whey powder. Products are sold under established brands like Dobryana, Ostankinskoye, 36 kopeyek, Ostrowia, and Milkiland. Founded in 1994, MLK Foods Public Company Ltd is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, and functions as a subsidiary of 1, Inc. Cooperatief U.A.
